newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chronology of mishaps at Japan state nuclear firm.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of mishaps at Japan state nuclear firm.

text.p: The following is a brief chronology of events related to accidents at facilities operated by the state-run Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corp (PNC):

December 8, 1995 - Massive leak of coolant at prototype fast-breeder reactor Monju, located in western Japan. Although there is no radiation leak outside the plant, Monju is shut down and has yet to resume operations.
December 10, 1995 - Initial investigation reveals three tonnes of the sodium coolant had leaked, pointing to a major accident.

January 13, 1996 - PNC public relations official probing Monju accident commits suicide after revelations that other PNC officials lied about the initial probe and kept secret a videotape of the accident scene.

March 11, 1997 - Fire at the PNC's nuclear fuel reprocessing plant located at Tokaimura, 100 km (65 miles) northeast of Tokyo. PNC reports fire at the nuclear waste treatment facility under control, but explosion nine hours later exposes 37 staff to radiation in Japan's worst nuclear accident.
Entire plant, which reprocesses 12 percent of Japan's spent nuclear fuel, is shut down.

March 17, 1997 - PNC's Uranium Fuel Production plant, also at Tokaimura, shut down after false alarm warning that fuel reached critical mass -- the point at which a nuclear reaction becomes self-sustaining.
March 20, 1997 - PNC submits formal report to government's Science and Technology Agency on the explosion but is forced to admit on April 8 that the report was falsified.
April 9, 1997 - Science and Technology Agency starts probe on false report.

April 15, 1997 - PNC says there was an accident the day before at the Fugen advanced thermal reactor in western Japan which leaked radioactive tritium. Local government officials say 11 workers exposed to low levels of radiation. Fugen ordered shut down by the government.

April 17, 1997 - PNC officials say there were 11 accidents at Fugen in the past three years involving minor leaks of radiation which were not reported at the time they occurred. Police start formal investigations into PNC over inaccurate report on Tokaimura explosion.
